test_title: PYST 20: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.**

Conducting in-depth research and analysis of a startup as part of creating an investment memo is an important step for potential investors to evaluate the __viability__ and potential of the startup.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Incredibility**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Viability **means the ability to work successfully or to be effective. (सफलतापूर्वक कार्य करने या प्रभावी होने की क्षमता)

 
 
• **Example**: *The viability of the new business model was questioned by many experts.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Incredibility **means the quality of being unbelievable or difficult to believe. (अविश्वसनीय या विश्वास करना कठिन होने का गुण)
 
 
• **Example**: The story he told about meeting aliens seemed to be met with incredibility among the audience.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Liability **means something that is legally responsible for something else. (कुछ ऐसा जो कानूनी तौर पर किसी और चीज़ के लिए ज़िम्मेदार है)
 
• **Feasibility **means something that is capable of being done or accomplished successfully. (कुछ ऐसा जो सफलतापूर्वक किया या पूरा किया जा सके)
 
• **Extempore **means something that is done without any preparation or planning. (कुछ ऐसा जो बिना किसी तैयारी या योजना के किया जाता है)
